description: Standalone MCP-UI server that renders Station's own orchestration sessions as a sandboxed panel (sessions_panel): state, provider, project, and last activity for every live session. Reads Station's local REST API (GET /orchestration/sessions); set STATION_API_BASE if Station is not on http://localhost:3141. Reference <serverId>/sessions_panel as an mcp-tool-ui layout component with mcpUiHost enabled.
